column1: # Callees check 1 accepts without a mention in the reconstruction.
# One entry per line, 4 TAB-separated fields:
# Patterns are fnmatch globs on demangled names with parameters stripped
#   exception-only  reached only from an exception landing pad; no source statement makes the call
#   abi-implicit    emitted by the GCC C++ ABI itself; no source statement makes the call
#   stock-inline    made inside stock ID_INLINE SDK code that the reconstruction calls by its SDK name
#                   (or inside a stock type's implicit destructor); the reason names the stock
#                   function and its file. One entry per function: never a wildcard function pattern
